notes:
Opportunity background: Borealis builds an AI-powered discovery layer for mid-market product catalogs (search + recommendations). They're performance-sensitive: median session latency target <80ms end-to-end for search+routing flows, rerank steps can tolerate slightly higher but prefer sub-200ms per query for interactive pages.

From discovery: customer prefers start on Hosted API for fast iteration, then evaluate Dedicated if cost or VPC/network isolation becomes necessary. Primary ask: a reranking endpoint that can accept offline scores and feature vectors for blended scoring + Redwood model re-ranking.

Customer quotes: 'We need predictable tail latency and a simple way to run offline scoring against our eval sets.' — Head of Product.

Security/deployment: want VPC peering and SAML SSO; retention controls and audit logs are must-haves for their enterprise customers. Data residency preference: US only for the pilot.

Procurement notes: legal reviewing DSPA and Data Processing Addendum; finance asked for 12-month committed pricing model for Dedicated baseline. Typical CRM shorthand in call notes.

POC scope proposed: (1) ingest 50k annotated queries + relevance judgments (NDCG labels) into Redwood eval harness, (2) run hosted rerank endpoint for A/B versus their current linear-ranker, (3) run offline batch scoring to validate throughput and per-token cost, (4) if metrics and cost look good, provide Dedicated capacity estimate for sustained 200 qps rerank load.
